author: Yffe
content:
Seeds the external anchor the acto-critic needs (goal.md verification model). Scope NOW: (1) conformance/sum.th and conformance/binary_search.th verbatim from thermite-design.md Appendix A and section 4.1. (2) conformance/sum.cert.json = the DETERMINISTIC SUBSET of Appendix A's certificate (level L3, contract_quality.{tautology=false,vacuous_precondition=false,mutants_killed='17/18',survivor=...}, effects=[pure], slag=false). solver_time_ms is EXCLUDED from cert-oracle comparison (non-deterministic). (3) conformance/README.md documenting the corpus contract + provenance + forward-declaration convention.

DEFERRED (do NOT fabricate now): tests/golden/lower/*.verus.rs (exact Verus syntax not pinned until .design/lower/verus-lowering.md exists -> author alongside issue #4); binary_search mutation fields (mutator set not defined until issue #12/v0.3); full cert JSON schema (pinned by .design/forge/certificate-manifest.md). Convention: each golden-cert field becomes a LIVE cert-oracle assertion when the component that produces it ships. Until then the oracle compares the fields present.
